Fare-free buses approved

Published 21 October 2026

At its meeting on 20 October, full council approved the Fare-Free Riverside motion by seven votes to two.

From 1 January 2027, travel on all Riverside bus routes will be free for everyone, with no pass or registration needed.

The scheme is funded by a workplace and retail parking levy. Full minutes of the meeting are available on the council website.
